name: Harness tool policy
description: Refuses a tool call the declared tool policy denies.

guard.title: Guard argv
guard.description: The guard to spawn, as argv. Written by harnesses/openclaw/install.sh; an empty or missing value refuses every tool call rather than passing it.

timeoutMs.title: Guard timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long the guard gets to answer before the call is refused for want of an answer.

policyVersion.title: Policy version
policyVersion.description: Version of the tool policy this fragment was generated from, so a stale config is visible.
